name: Maria Santos
occupation: Nurse at a hospital in Doha
background: Filipino expatriate, six years in Qatar. Monthly salary QAR 12,000. Two children aged 6 and 9 living with her in Doha. She has about QAR 20,000 in her current account and wants to put aside around QAR 2,000 a month.
stated_goal: Wants to open a savings account.
personality: Polite, warm and a little cautious. Answers questions fully and honestly.

hidden_needs.topic: long-term goals, children's future, or what the savings are for
hidden_needs.fact: She wants to pay for both children's university studies, starting in about 9 years.

hidden_needs.topic: regular payments, family abroad, or sending money overseas
hidden_needs.fact: She sends QAR 3,000 every month to her parents in Manila and pays high transfer fees.

hidden_needs.topic: attitude to risk, investment experience, or past financial losses
hidden_needs.fact: She lost QAR 15,000 in an online investment scheme two years ago and now wants no risk to her savings.
